{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Create a modern static entertainment news event website called STARBUZZ LIVE 2026 using Astro. It should feel like a premium Twitter-inspired festival/news hub where fans can follow celebrity panels, movie announcements, music drops, red carpet moments, and creator interviews, but everything must be fully static with mock/sample content only. No backend, no login, no API, no database, no real social feed.

# Website Goal
Build a stylish event-site for a fictional entertainment news weekend. The site should look like a live social/news experience even though all content is prewritten static content. Use a clean dark-first modern UI with glass cards, rounded panels, subtle gradients, sticky navigation, hover effects, and responsive layouts.

# Required Pages / Sections

## 1. Home Page
- Hero section with event name: STARBUZZ LIVE 2026
- Tagline: Entertainment News. Fan Reactions. Red Carpet Energy.
- Big CTA buttons: View Schedule, Explore Headlines
- Hero should include a mock trending ticker inspired by Twitter trends
- Add featured story cards with category labels like Movies, Music, Streaming, Red Carpet, Celebrity Buzz
- Include a side panel called “What’s Trending” with static hashtags such as #StarbuzzLive, #RedCarpetWatch, #TrailerDrop, #FanCamMoment
- Add hover animation on news cards and buttons

## 2. News Feed Page / Section
Create a Twitter-like editorial feed using static cards:
- Each post card has avatar circle, source name, handle, time, headline, short paragraph, image placeholder, tags, and reaction numbers
- Use sample sources like Starbuzz Desk, PopFrame, StreamScene, Red Carpet Room
- Include fake reply / repost / like icons or text counters, only visual not functional
- Cards should have hover lift effect and border glow
- Add filter chips visually: All, Movies, Music, TV, Awards, Viral, Interviews. These do not need real filtering unless easy with front-end JS, static is fine.

## 3. Event Schedule
A detailed multi-day schedule for a fictional entertainment news event:
- Day 1: Opening Buzz, Trailer Reveals, Fan Poll Recap, Late Night Interview Stage
- Day 2: Streaming Stars, Music Spotlight, Creator Roundtable, Red Carpet Preview
- Day 3: Awards Watch, Celebrity Q&A, Final Headlines, Afterparty Recap
- Each session card should include time, title, host, stage, short description, category badge
- Use timeline layout on desktop and stacked cards on mobile
- Add hover effects on each schedule item

## 4. Spotlight Speakers / Guests
Create a guest grid with fictional entertainment journalists, hosts, critics, stylists, fan creators, and interviewers.
Each card should include:
- Name
- Role
- Short bio
- Social-style handle text
- Topic tags
- Image placeholder or gradient avatar
- Hover effect that reveals “Featured Session” text

## 5. Red Carpet Highlights
Static showcase section with big editorial image cards:
- Best Dressed Moments
- Surprise Cast Reunion
- Viral Interview Clips
- Music Icon Arrival
- Breakout Star Watch
- Streaming Series Cast Panel
Include dramatic layout, overlay text, category badges, hover zoom effect.

## 6. Trending Hashtag Wall
Build a visual hashtag wall like a social platform trends panel:
- Each hashtag card includes rank number, hashtag, short trend description, and fake post count
- Make it visually inspired by Twitter/X trend cards but not an exact copy
- Use static example hashtags only
- Add hover effect and subtle animated shine/background

## 7. Editorial Categories
Create a section with category tiles:
- Movie News
- Music Drops
- Streaming Watch
- Celebrity Interviews
- Award Season
- Style Desk
- Fan Reactions
- Viral Moments
Each tile should have icon-style visual, short description, and hover interaction.

## 8. Newsletter / Reminder Section
Static newsletter-looking section only:
- Email input field can be visual only or show a small front-end-only success message
- Text: Get the daily Starbuzz recap in your inbox
- No real form submission, no backend
- Include clear microcopy: Static demo form, no real signup required

## 9. Footer
Include:
- Logo / site name
- Navigation links
- Mock social links
- Disclaimer: This is a fictional static entertainment news event site with sample content.
- Copyright line

# Design Requirements
- Modern premium entertainment news look
- Twitter-inspired feed layout: sticky left nav or top nav, central content feed, right trend sidebar on desktop
- Must be mobile responsive
- Dark theme with optional light sections if it looks good
- Use colors like black, charcoal, electric blue, neon pink, violet gradients, white text
- Large bold typography for headlines
- Smooth hover effects: card lift, glow borders, button transitions, image zoom, tag highlight
- Use good spacing, visual hierarchy, and editorial card layout
- Include enough content so the page feels complex and complete

# Tech Requirements
- Use Astro for the static website
- Plain CSS, Astro components, and optional small vanilla JS only for simple UI effects
- No backend, no database, no authentication, no real API calls
- Use mock/static data arrays for articles, schedule, guests, hashtags, and highlights
- Site must work as a static build
- Organize components cleanly, for example: Hero, FeedCard, TrendPanel, ScheduleTimeline, GuestCard, HighlightGrid, Newsletter, Footer

# Extra Polish
- Add sticky navigation
- Add active-looking nav links
- Add scroll-friendly sections
- Add animated marquee/ticker for breaking entertainment headlines using static text
- Add accessible alt text and semantic HTML
- Add responsive breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop
- Make hover states noticeable but smooth

Deliver the full static Astro site with realistic placeholder content and polished styling.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
